chunks: And from him, from Al-Jamourani, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Muhammad ibn Yusuf Al-Taymi, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far, from his father, from his forefathers (peace be upon them), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who neglects marriage out of fear of poverty, has had a poor opinion of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.'
Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says: 'If they are poor, Allah will enrich them from His bounty.'
ai.seo_question: Why should one not delay marriage due to fear of poverty?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this hadith links the spiritual act of marriage to divine provision (rizq), framing the fear of poverty as a deficiency in tawakkul (trust in God). It explicitly cites Surah An-Nur 24:32 to support the principle that God enriches the deserving from His bounty, a concept central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the encouragement of marriage for those capable of fulfilling its duties.

en.hubeali:
And from him, from Al Jamourany, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Muhammad Bin Yusuf Al Taymi, 
(It has been narrated) from Muhammad son of Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who neglects the marriage fearing the poverty, so he has offended Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic with his conjecture.
Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [24:32] if they are poor, Allah would Enrich them out of His Grace’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from al-Jamuraniy from al-Hassan ibn Ali ibn abu Hamzah from Muhammad ibn Yusuf al-Tamimiy from Muhammad ibn Ja’far from his father from ancestors who has said the following:

“He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘One who neglects marriage because of his fear to feed his dependents has become cynical about Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious,
who has said, “If they are poor Allah makes rich through His generosity.’”” (24: 32)
